name: call-frequency-max-availability-for-the-whole-evaluable-range-is-clean
why: THE HONEST HALF OF THE PAIR ABOVE. Same world, same schedule, same rule: availability covers every date of the evaluable range, the window holds six available days, one call in every three permits two, and the two calls in it are exactly at the allowance. Green at the boundary rather than trivially - a case that passed with room to spare would not show that the denominator is what moved.
